claims.subject: Danish Crown
claims.object: Dinklage, Essen/Oldenburg, Husum, Oldenburg, Schüttorf and Teterow
claims.claim: Danish Crown's current factories-and-abattoirs page lists six German locations: Dinklage, Essen/Oldenburg, Husum, Oldenburg, Schüttorf and Teterow.
claims.boundary: A location listing does not mean every site performs the same activity or identify animal origin and product destination.
claims.falsification_condition: A newer Danish Crown location page materially changes the German site list.

claims.subject: Danish Crown Fleisch GmbH
claims.claim: Danish Crown lists Danish Crown Fleisch GmbH at its Essen/Oldenburg location.
claims.boundary: A legal entity listed at a site does not prove the origin of a specific animal or current ownership of every asset there.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or official record identifies a different legal entity for the location.

claims.subject: Schlachtzentrum Nordfriesland GmbH
claims.claim: Danish Crown lists Schlachtzentrum Nordfriesland GmbH at its Husum location and separately identifies Husum as a German beef location.
claims.source_title: Danish Crown — Fabriken und Schlachthöfe / Büros Rind
claims.boundary: This does not prove which farms or animals supplied Husum on a particular date.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or official facility record changes the entity or site function.

claims.subject: Danish Crown Teterower Fleisch GmbH
claims.claim: Danish Crown lists Danish Crown Teterower Fleisch GmbH at its Teterow location.
claims.boundary: The site/entity link does not establish a farm, shipment, product or customer path.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or official record changes the entity or site status.

claims.subject: Danish Crown Germany
claims.claim: In January 2023 Danish Crown announced that German pig slaughter and primary cutting would be concentrated at its Essen/Oldenburg slaughter operation while the Boizenburg cutting plant was to close.
claims.boundary: This is a 2023 restructuring announcement and must not be treated as a complete description of the current 2026 German production network.
claims.falsification_condition: Later company or official records show the announced restructuring did not occur or was subsequently reversed.

claims.subject: Friland Deutschland GmbH
claims.object: contract farmers and partner slaughter/cutting plants in Germany
claims.claim: Danish Crown's Friland materials state that Friland works closely with contract farmers in Germany and Denmark and that German organic animals are slaughtered and cut under contract by long-standing QS- or IFS-certified partner plants.
claims.source_title: Danish Crown / Friland — Ihre Spezialisten für Bio-Fleisch
claims.boundary: The source does not name each German contract farmer or partner slaughter plant and therefore does not prove a specific farm-to-facility path.
claims.falsification_condition: A current Friland/Danish Crown disclosure materially changes the German contract-farmer or partner-processing model.
